prompt:
Aspect ratio 16:9, landscape. Desktop WEBSITE DESIGN MOCKUP, a screen design, not a photograph.
GROUND: dark warm-black photo-album card page #14120F, fibrous heavy black album stock, faint vertical binding gutter down the centre — an opened double page.
DOMINANT, spanning almost the whole frame: NOT one big photograph but NINE photographs of different sizes scattered across both halves, overlapping slightly, each held by white paper photo corners, each rotated a degree or two differently. They show a narrow Atlantic peninsula city, a tall sailing ship at a quay, a white cathedral dome, a sherry cellar with dark barrels, a beach at evening, narrow white streets, a rock rising from the sea, a fish market, a ferry deck. Two large anchor the halves, three medium, four small. Black card shows through between them as breathing room.
MARGINALIA in silver pencil in the gaps: "03.09 Ankunft", "07.09 Gibraltar", "10.09 Rota", "15.09 El Puerto", angled naturally as handwriting.
TWO STRIPS of pale ochre washi tape #C98A3E hold two photographs onto the black ground.
UPPER LEFT: title "Cadiz 2026" in silver pencil, smaller line "zwei Wochen am Atlantik".
LOWER EDGE, narrow band: fourteen small torn-edge paper tabs #F2F0EB left to right, each with a handwritten date. Four carry a small deep-blue #0F3B57 notch. One is visibly empty.
COMMITMENT: the dominant move is DENSITY — a whole spread of accumulated photographs, as a real album page looks with two weeks laid out at once. No single image dominates; the accumulation is the point.
PALETTE: #14120F, #0F3B57, #C98A3E, #C6362C, #F2F0EB.
AVOID: serif display typography, centred hero text over full-bleed photo, rounded-corner card grids, gradient overlays, glassmorphism, neon, drop shadows beyond what a photo corner casts.
structural_question: Aufgeschlagene Doppelseite mit neun Fotos verschiedener Groesse. Dichte statt Fokus: die Anhaeufung ist das Argument.
